scope: Exact-byte technical review of prospective simplified scoring authority only

C04 requires exactly one context without inherited conversation or review history, only authorized inputs, restricted capabilities, opaque keys, and a private exact-delivery manifest; it makes no OS inaccessibility claim

C06 requires separate owner unblinding authorization after verified score freeze
C07 keeps adoption, commit and execution distinct; this review grants none
